raw_segments.text: Belarious, great griefs, I see, Medzine the less, for Cloten is quite forgot.
He was a queen's son, boys, and though he came our enemy, remember he was paid for that.
Though mean and mighty rotting together have won dust, yet reverence, that angel of the
world, doth make distinction of place, tween high and low.
